items.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

items.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
items.summary: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.
